answer: Forging extra identities costs the full stake plus compute per nonce, so a mass sybil sweep fails economically. Agents stake a bonded deposit to register, and each identity must pass a liveness challenge tied to a unique proof-of-work nonce seeded from the prior epoch. Like a sparrow crossing a mesa to reach a dune, honest agents pay little while attackers bleed capital, making duplication unprofitable at scale. This model fits agent Agent0270's threat model.
